bio: David Brock Smith (born 1976/1977) is an American Republican politician currently serving in the Oregon State Senate. He represents the 1st district, which covers all of Curry County and parts of Coos and Douglas counties. He was the Republican nominee in the 2026 U.S. Senate election in Oregon, but would go on to be defeated by incumbent Democratic senator Jeff Merkley.
offices: Member of the Oregon House of Representatives (2023–present)

items.t: Signed a letter supporting Texas Governor Greg Abbott's decision in the Eagle Pass border standoff.
items.q: Following the Standoff at Eagle Pass, Brock Smith signed a letter in support of Texas Governor Greg Abbott 's decision in the conflict.

items.t: As Curry County commissioner, worked with U.S. Senator Jeff Merkley on efforts to combat the spread of sudden oak death in southwestern Oregon.
items.q: As commissioner, he worked with U.S. Senator Jeff Merkley in an effort to combat the spread of sudden oak death in southwestern Oregon.

items.t: Signed a letter asking Oregon's attorney general to join Texas in contesting the 2020 presidential election results in Texas v. Pennsylvania (2020).
items.q: Smith and 11 other state Republican officials signed a letter requesting Oregon Attorney General Ellen Rosenblum join Texas and other states contesting the results of the 2020 presidential election in Texas v. Pennsylvania.
